Name: Candace
Dialog: (from inside) C'mon, c'mon...

Name: Candace (cont'd)
Dialog: ...Stace! Cover me! We need to find...

Name: Candace (cont'd)
Dialog: ...the Bridge across the Dumbledown River before that stupid gopher!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on laptop) I got your back, girl! Coin!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm on it!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: C'mon! C'mon! (Ducky Momo retrieves the coin) Nice! You did it, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! Third on the leaderboard, baby! That digital Ducky Momo trophy...will...be...mine!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ours.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ours.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (walking in with a piece of paper) Candace, oh, good, you're up. You'll have plenty of time to tackle the list of chores that you've let pile up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, Mom, Stacy and I are this close to kicking leaderboard butt in Ducky Momo's Golden Quest!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, your chores better be done before I get back from running my errands.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No problemo, Mom! You're lookin' at the queen of mul...ti...tas...king!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Just make sure you hit the whole list, Your Majesty. (leaves) See ya later.

Name: Candace
Dialog: 'Kay! (back on laptop) Ooh! Ooh! Squirrel bandits!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ha! You lose, bro! Eye shifts count! Ya moved!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Actually, you did, too. Since our planet's orbit of speed around the sun is 67,000 miles per hour and you are on its surface and speeding around the sun as well. (Buford spins the hat on Baljeet's head.) Quit it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool hat, Baljeet!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Thank you! I got it at Astro Camp today. (Buford spins it again.) Quit turbocharging the orbital speed of my solar system!

Name: Buford
Dialog: What? I'm racin' 'em against each other. (Spins it again.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it! I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Smack Baljeet's head around?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No! We're gonna build a solar system and race the planets!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Only if I can still smack around Baljeet's hat!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hey, where is Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Only you can make the decision to succeed. You've got to dig down deep within yourself and grab ahold of your dream! (pause) Go ahead. Grab it. (beat) I'll wait. (Agent P drops in.) Oh, Agent P! Uh, I've been giving a motivational speech to the interns, and, uh, by "interns", I mean Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Very inspirational, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anyway, Doofenshmirtz has rented out a conference hall at the Danville Motel Inn and is giving some kind of motivational lecture. Who would want motivation from him is beyond me, but, well, that's beside the point. Pick up your credentials at the front desk. (Perry the Chimneypus salutes.) Good luck, Agent P! (Perry's chair lowers back and is launched from it by a spring.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm all hooked up and ready to multitask. First on the list, wash dishes. (She dusts the table while walking. Sidenote: Don't try this at home.) Now where did we leave off?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on laptop) I think we were headed into the forest with the Grizzly King. Are you sure you don't wanna wait until you finished your chores?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, please, Stacy, I've got everything under control. Let's tackle the Mountain King's dishes!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey, Phineas, whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I were just heading up to our solar system speedway. We're gonna have a planet race.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Cool!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The first one to complete 50 laps around the sun wins the Galaxy 5000! Technically, it should be "The Galaxy 50", but, y'know, "The Galaxy 5000" sounds so much cooler. (Cut to the top level, where Irving is seen at the control panel.) Ferb is racing Mercury, the closest planet to the sun. (Ferb puts on his helmet and gives a thumbs-up and gets sucked up a tube into his racing planet.) I'm racing Mars. I saved Venus for you.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Aw, because Venus is the goddess of love?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (shrugs) Actually, I didn't even think of that. But sure. (Phineas and Isabella put on their helmets and get sucked up the tubes.)

Name: Irving
Dialog: Alright, racers, status check!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Saturn, check!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oo-ran-ohs, check!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, that is not how it is pronounced!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It is on this channel!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Venus?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Intergalactic Planetary Racing Patch, check!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Mars?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All ready!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Earth?

Name: Jenny
Dialog: Earth is ready to go!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Neptune?

Name: Balthazar
Dialog: Check!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Jupiter?

Name: Django
Dialog: Check!

Name: Albert
Dialog: Pluto is go!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Albert?! What are you doing here?! Pluto isn't even a planet!

Name: Albert
Dialog: That is still in dispute.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Racers, start your planets!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Right out of the gate, Earth is in the lead, with Jupiter and Neptune rushing up to the challenge, but they take each other out! The Fireside Girls maintain their lead!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Watch out for the falling fiery marshmallows, Stace!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on laptop) I'll turn them into s'mores with my super sugar squeal! Bye bye, Wonder Kid!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I'll go collect the coins in the Cocoa Campground. Now to get the laundry started!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Welcome, you lucky people in attendance, I am Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz and I'm here to introduce you to my eight-step program for ruling the Tri-State Area! I- I mean overcoming obstacles and the path to self-fulfillment. Heh, heh! Right! Nothing evil there. Anywho, behold, the Inator Method! Hit it, Norm!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's what I'm talkin' about! Yeah! (Agent P drops in) P-Perry the Platypus, what are you doin' here? Y-You're not supposed to be here 'til step 3. (to audience) You'll have to excuse me while I confer with my visual aid. (to Perry) I'm on stage, so I'm going to have to forego the long backstory. Suffice it to say, there was a judge's ruling involved, okay? Anyway, just take a seat in the back and I'll cue you when you're on. (Perry exits) Perry the Platypus, ladies and gentlemen! You'll be seeing more of him later during the nemesis portion of the seminar.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, sweet! We made it to the golden key of the Crumblebum Dwarfs!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on laptop) Candace, it's the gopher!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (not paying attention to how much detergent she's putting in) I'll put a stop to you, you gold key-swipin' gopher!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on laptop) Just get the key! Oh, man!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aw, stupid gopher!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Now we're back to third place!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! I guess we'll just have to get him on the next level. (looks at detergent) Did I put the..? (shrugs) Hmm. (puts in the last of the detergent) Better clean than dirty. (Closes the lid and turns the washing machine on.) I'm one totally focused multitasking genius!

Name: Irving
Dialog: It's a virtual dead-heat with the planetary trine between Mercury, Mars and Venus! Phineas is out in front by a pointed nose! But check out the cool inverted move from Ferb! Watch out, boys! Venus is risin' fast!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: She went intra-Venus right between us.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, so now that we got the basics covered, we can get to the fun part. Let's start with trapping your nemesis. (Cut to Perry with a nametag lanyard on taking notes. He gets trapped by the lanyard.) Nametag, you're it!

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters angrily)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The keys to a good trap are the element of surprise and, also, if you can work in a good pun. That's always nice.

Name: Man
Dialog: Uh, what about constraint and effectiveness?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, th-that'll be covered in the thwarting portion of our seminar. Don't...Don't get ahead of yourself. Okay, step four is the big reveal! (Takes tarp off his inator.) Behold: the Motivate-inator! (The screen behind him says "Music Sting", which plays.) The music sting. That totally ups the drama. So what does it do? I'm glad you asked! You, come on up here, I'll sh-I'll show ya. Let's give him a big hand for being such a sport, shall we? (The dude that asked the question in the audience comes up to applause.) Alright, what's your name?

Name: Man
Dialog: Billy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (shakes Billy's hand) Great to meet ya, Billy! Tell me, (motions toward the back of the room) whadaya see over there in the back of the room?

Name: Billy
Dialog: Uh...I dunno, a table full of stuff?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Did everyone take note of his reply? (walks behind the inator) Totally lackluster. But that's all gonna change. Okay, Billy, now hold still. (Fires the inator on Billy) Now whadaya see, Billy?

Name: Billy
Dialog: (excitedly gasps) Inator Method merchandise! (runs up to the counter and purchases practically everything) Tapes, DVDs, books, audiobooks, now! Now! T-shirts, hats, that is so cool! I gotta have 'em!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now look at him! All full of pep! He's completely motivated!

Name: Man #2
Dialog: (speaking in a female voice) Wait a second! He's just motivated to buy your junk! This is nothin' but a money-makin' scam!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Exactly, what better motivation is there? (zaps the entire audience and they storm the merchandise counter)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nice work, Stace! That last mega-wallow in the Razzleberry Swamp puts us back in second place. (lets go of the vacuum, which attempts to suck the rug right up)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on laptop) What?! I can barely hear you over the vacuum!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, hang on. (leaves the room and the vacuum still on) Is that better?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Testimonials, take one.

Name: Man #3
Dialog: I came to this seminar with no intention of buying anything and look at all this junk I bought!

Name: Man #4
Dialog: Holy cow, I bought a lotta stuff I don't need!

Name: Margaret
Dialog: I just can't stop spending my money on the Inator Method's motivational products!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Woohoo! With all the cash I'm raking in, I'll be able to take over the Tri-State Area in no time! (A woman gives him a book, which he signs.) Thank you very much. Nice doin' business with ya.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) And who do I make this out to?

Name: Man #5
Dialog: (offscreen) Uncle Phil.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "To Uncle Phil, I'm wishing you the worst. Dr. Heinz Doofen—" Ow! (He gets kicked by Perry.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) This is it, Stace! The Golden Treasure of Utter Momosity! Oh, no, you don't! Leap of doom!

Name: Candace and Stacy
Dialog: (Cheer)

Name: Irving
Dialog: Buford is in the lead with Baljeet close behind!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ha ha! I am going to run rings around you, Ice Giant!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Bring it on, dweeb!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Eat my dust, Buford!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Ooh! The silent-but-deadly planet has left for parts unknown! (A horn is sounded and a robotic arm waves a checkered flag.) And Baljeet wins the digital trophy!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Victory!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, hold still so I can throw the book at ya! (Perry throws one at him) Ow! (The book hits the inator, which, as always, zaps out the window and hits an unsuspecting driver, who stops outside the backyard and sees the solar system.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great race, Baljeet!

Name: Trucker
Dialog: 'Scuse me, I don't normally run into strangers' backyards, but I'm inexplicably motivated to buy your solar system racetrack. How much?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Five bucks.

Name: Trucker
Dialog: Sold!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm home! How did you do on that lis—Oh! (gets grabbed by Candace)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom Mom Mom, you gotta see what Phineas and Ferb built in the backyard!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, the living room!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pushes her mother out) I know! I vacuumed!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) C'mon! C'mon!

Name: Linda
Dialog: But the laundry!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (keeps pushing her mother) I know! I just have to fold it!

Name: Linda
Dialog: The dishes?

Name: Candace
Dialog: All done and ready to be put away! (Now outside; with her eyes closed) Look!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom! Hi, Candace!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, kids. Well, at least the backyard isn't a mess.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Come on, Candace, (walks back inside) you have a lot of cleaning up to do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But...but but but...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that was a lot of interplanetary fun!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Plus, we made five bucks!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We should put that in the bank.

Name: Buford
Dialog: At 1% interest?! Are you kiddin'?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Noooooo!!!! Ah, man! Now I'm gonna have to use the money I made for repairs and medical bills.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, now, now, wai-wait! (He walks out the building and looks both directions. He then runs and screams as the planetary race track goes by.) AAAaaah!!! Curse you, Perry the Platypus!!!
